units.source_text: 源氏公子做梦也不曾想到明石姬也来了。

en.t: Prince Genji had never dreamed that the Akashi lady had come as well.

units.source_text: 这一晚通宵飨宴歌舞，举行种种仪式，以取悦神心。

en.t: All through that night there were feasts, songs, and dances, and many rites were performed to please the heart of the deity.

units.source_text: 其隆重超过了以前所许的愿。

en.t: The ceremony was even more magnificent than the vow that had been made before.

units.source_text: 神前奏乐规模盛大，直至天明。

en.t: Music was played before the shrine on a grand scale until daybreak.

units.source_text: 惟光等以前曾共患难之人，深深地感谢神明的恩德。

en.t: Koremitsu and the others who had once shared his hardships deeply thanked the gods for their grace.

units.source_text: 源氏公子偶尔外出，惟光便上前求见，献奉诗篇：

en.t: When Prince Genji happened to step outside, Koremitsu came forward to ask for an audience and offered this poem:
